purpose: T3.2 worst-case VRAM measurement to decide micro-batch size
gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 Laptop GPU, 6141 MiB total, ~861 MiB used by other desktop apps

dry_run.note: 16 examples (mostly ~150-token sequences), 3 optimizer steps, batch 1, eval batch 4; train_time 28.5 s; adapter reload verified (reload_ok=true); adapter isolated under training/smoke/t3_dry_run/adapter (not deleted, quarantined from the real adapter dir)

probes.verdict: OOM - exceeds 6141 MiB total; micro-batch 2 REJECTED
fits with ~1.4 GB headroom; worst case = the 2 longest corpus examples padded to 1024

decision.rationale: batch 2 measured OOM on worst-case (longest) sequences; batch 1 worst case 4.69 GB fits. Dry-run average-case peak was essentially identical (4.70 GB), so activation memory at batch 1 is dominated by the longest sequence, not the average.
